data.name: WriteActionRowsOne
data.comment: A statement in the list of writes of the open transaction. {0} = rows written (1), {1} = statement, e.g. "UPDATE ORDERS"

data.name: WriteActionRowsOther
data.comment: A statement in the list of writes of the open transaction. {0} = rows written, {1} = statement, e.g. "UPDATE ORDERS"

data.name: RowLockedByOtherSession
data.value: Another session has locked the row.

data.name: RowChangedByOthers
data.value: Someone else has changed the row in the meantime.

data.name: RowGone
data.value: The row no longer exists – it has been deleted in the meantime.

data.name: WriteFailedUnique
data.value: Unique constraint violated – this value already exists.
data.comment: ORA-00001, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedCheck
data.comment: ORA-02290, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedParentMissing
data.value: Foreign key violated – the referenced record does not exist.
data.comment: ORA-02291, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedChildrenExist
data.value: Foreign key violated – dependent records still exist.
data.comment: ORA-02292, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedNotNull
data.comment: ORA-01400/ORA-01407, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedValueTooLong
data.value: Value too long for the column.
data.comment: ORA-12899, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedNumberTooLarge
data.value: Number too large for the column.
data.comment: ORA-01438, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedNoPrivilege
data.value: No privilege to change this table.
data.comment: ORA-01031, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedReadOnly
data.comment: ORA-01456, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: WriteFailedOther
data.comment: Any other Oracle error while writing, followed by Oracle's message

data.name: EditInLobEditor
data.comment: {0} = data type of the column, e.g. CLOB

data.name: NumberTooPreciseToEdit
data.value: Numbers with more than 28 digits cannot be edited here.

data.name: RowMarkedForDeletion
data.value: The row is marked for deletion.

data.name: NotALobColumn
data.comment: {0} = column name

data.name: WorkspaceReadOnlyUnlockToEdit
data.value: The workspace is read-only – unlock it to make changes.
data.comment: Why a form field cannot be edited

data.name: ExportSkippedOne
data.comment: Export warning. {0} = number of values (1), {1} = column name, {2} = data type, {3} = reason (ExportReason…)

data.name: ExportSkippedOther
data.comment: Export warning. {0} = number of values, {1} = column name, {2} = data type, {3} = reason (ExportReason…)

data.name: ExportReasonOnlyLength
data.comment: Reason in an export warning (lower case, ends a sentence): only the length of the BLOB was loaded

data.name: ExportReasonOnlyPreview
data.comment: Reason in an export warning (lower case, ends a sentence): only the first characters of the CLOB were loaded

data.name: ExportReasonTypeNotExported
data.comment: Reason in an export warning (lower case, ends a sentence): values of this data type are not exported

data.name: LobEmpty
data.comment: Grid cell of an empty (not NULL) LOB

data.name: CharacterCountOne
data.comment: Length of a text. {0} = number of characters (1)

data.name: CharacterCountOther
data.comment: Length of a text. {0} = number of characters

data.name: ByteCountOne
data.comment: Size of binary data. {0} = number of bytes (1)

data.name: ByteCountOther
data.comment: Size of binary data. {0} = number of bytes
